newsitem.title: USA: JFAX Personal Telecom starts E-mail-to-fax service.
newsitem.headline: JFAX Personal Telecom starts E-mail-to-fax service.

text.p: JFAX Personal Telecom said on Monday it started a low-cost E-mail to facsimile machine service which it said undercuts FaxSav Inc, NetCentric Corp, Faxaway International and others.
The service, JFAX Send, costs $0.05 for a one page fax received in the U.S. from any E-mail user anywhere in the world, if it took less than 30 seconds to transmit.
There are no additional hardware or software costs. Payments on the service are handled by a prepaid card account of between $10 and $250. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
